text: ポケモンの　のうりょくを　あげる　アイテムを　かいに　きたんだ！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　のうりょくを　あげる　アイテムを

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a verb of coming or going tells what you come or go to do. かいに　きた = 'came to buy'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンの　のうりょくを　あげる　アイテム
patterns.explanation: A short sentence placed right before a thing describes that thing. のうりょくを　あげる　アイテム = 'items that raise stats'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ (short for のだ) gives an explaining tone, telling why he is here. きたんだ = 'I came, you see'.
